name: More Life Company Corp.
summary: The More Life Co. Corp. is a biotechnology company, which engages in the provision of solutions to optimize human, animal, and plant health. Its patented technologies includes Quicksome™ and Quicksol™. The Quicksome™ patented technology utilizes proprietary formulations and stabilizing molecules to encapsulate and formulate active ingredients into product formats that, if successfully commercialized, could enhance the efficacy of molecule delivery across a variety of nutraceutical product applications. The Quicksol™ patented is a solubilization technology, which has been developed to provide solubilized drug delivery options. The company was founded on March 8, 2005 and is headquartered in Vaughan, Canada.
